title: Lafcadio Hearn’s Former Residence — Visitor Guide

facts.fact: Hearn and Setsu lived here for about five months from June1891; the garden is integral to the house visit.
facts.excerpt: In June, 1891, Lafcadio Hearn and his wife, Setsu, moved into this property
